---
title: FAQ
---

## Do I have to call `global_init()` before decorating routes?

No. Explicit template paths are only used at request time, and auto-named templates are resolved at the first request. Decorate routes at import and call `global_init()` from `main()` if you prefer.

## Why does my second `global_init()` call do nothing?

`cache_init` defaults to `True`, which makes later calls no-ops while the engine is initialized. Pass `cache_init=False`, or call `clear()` first. See [Configuration](configuration.qmd).

## Can one handler render different templates?

Yes. Build the alternative with `response('other.pt', ...)` and return it. A returned `Response` passes through the decorator untouched. See [Rendering outside handlers](lower-level-api.qmd).

## How do I return a 404 outside a decorated handler?

`not_found()` only works inside `@template` handlers. Elsewhere, return `response('errors/404.pt', status_code=404, message='...')`. See [Friendly 404 pages](not-found.qmd).

## Why did my 404 page come back as HTML from an XML endpoint?

`not_found()` always renders as `text/html` with status 404. For another format, build the response yourself with `response()`.

## How do I set a cookie on a rendered page?

Put a callable under the `__response_callback__` key in the returned dict. It is called with the built `Response`. See [the decorator guide](template-decorator.qmd#setting-cookies-or-headers-on-a-rendered-page).

## Can I use `.html` files instead of `.pt`?

Yes. The loader ignores the extension. Auto-naming looks for `.html` first and then `.pt`.

## My Alpine.js or htmx attributes break the template

Pass `restricted_namespace=False` to `global_init()`. See [Writing templates](templates.qmd#alpine-htmx).

## Can Chameleon and Jinja2 templates coexist in one app?

Yes. Nothing in this package touches Robyn's Jinja2 support. Use `@template` or `ChameleonTemplate` for Chameleon pages and Robyn's `JinjaTemplate` for the rest.

## Does it work with chameleon-partials?

Yes, with no extra configuration. Initialize both packages with the same template folder and pass `render_partial` through the model. See [Writing templates](templates.qmd#reusable-components-with-chameleon-partials).

## How do I test a handler?

Call it directly and assert on the returned `Response`. No server needed. See [Testing your handlers](testing.qmd).

## Is the API stable?

Not yet. The project is in alpha. The surface is small and the current names are expected to stay, but there are no guarantees until 1.0.

## Where is the template language documented?

At [chameleon.readthedocs.io](https://chameleon.readthedocs.io/). The [cheat sheet](templates.qmd#tal-cheat-sheet) covers the parts you need day to day.
